name: Monitoring & SIEM Service
description: A monitoring and SIEM service — also called the observability/logging platform, Splunk/Elastic/Datadog, log aggregator, or security analytics tier — that ingests telemetry and security events, correlates them, and raises alerts. The backbone of detection and incident response. The place to look for monitoring, the SIEM, log aggregation/observability, alerting, or where telemetry and security events are collected and analyzed.
